messages:
andrea.sre: :rotating_light: ACME (customer) reporting repeated 502/504s from the hosted inference API starting ~08:02 UTC. They also say billing shows duplicate usage events. Opening this thread for triage.
carla.support: Customer provided request id: rq_0a7c4f2b. They say 30% of requests returned 502 and some were billed twice (two requests with same client id in a short window). Logs attached from their side show client retry logic kicking in.
ben.runtime: Looking at our hosted-inference gateway dashboard — 08:02–08:10 shows upstream 502s from model-host pool: modelhost-eu-3. Error signature: "upstream read timed out" and lots of connection resets. No spike in CPU on the model hosts though.
dmitri.oncall: Repro locally with curl (from us-east):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"small test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream read timed out","upstream_host":"modelhost-eu-3"}
```
ben.runtime: I pulled modelhost logs around 08:02 — we see many connections hitting keepalive timeouts and the model process tearing down sockets with errno 104. There was a small GC pause cluster-wide (~200ms) but not enough to explain all failures.
john.infra: Noted: we ran a kernel backport patch to eu-west edge nodes at 00:15 which adjusted TCP keepalive defaults (lowered tcp_keepalive_intvl). Rolling that across some nodes at 00:15 could change behavior under burst. I will correlate node list.
maya.product: Customer claims duplicates show as two distinct billing events with slightly different timestamps (<1s apart). Could be client retry + successful response recorded twice or a gateway double-forward. Carla, can you share the exact client behavior? :thinking:
carla.support: Customer says their client retries after 250ms if no response. They see one 502 then immediately 200 for the same request id. They got billed for both. They attached client log showing retry after socket timeout.
ben.runtime: Hypothesis: intermittent drop between gateway and modelhost causing gateway to respond 502 while backend eventually serves, and our billing/ingestion path double-records when backend callback arrives after gateway response. There's a race in the usage-event ack path.
emily.sre-lead: Agreed this looks like two issues: (A) transient connection failures between gateway and modelhost (likely keepalive/tuning/GC) (B) billing ingestion emitting events on both gateway-close and modelhost-success. Both need fixes and a mitigation now.
dmitri.oncall: Immediate mitigations I can do now:
- Put ACME org on a temporary bypass route to modelhost-eu-standby (different pool) (will do if infra ok)
- Increase gateway upstream timeouts from 200ms to 1s for modelhost to reduce false 502s
- Enable fail-fast circuit-breaker so retries don't amplify
I can roll the timeout bump in next 5m if infra ✅.
john.infra: Don't bump timeouts blindly — if the kernel tcp keepalive behavior changed, longer timeouts may just increase request backlog. I'll identify nodes that had the kernel patch and roll them back on suspect hosts immediately.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-278. Assigned to emily.sre-lead, ben.runtime, john.infra. War room link: https://zoom.example/warroom-INC-2026-278
ben.runtime: Quick hotfix plan:
1) Patch billing ingestion to dedupe events for identical request ids within 5s window (short-term) — ben + carla
2) Add robust ack handshake so billing only records on final outcome (mid-term)
3) Investigate keepalive / kernel patch interaction and GC pauses (ben + john)
I'll open PR for dedupe now.
carla.support: I'll inform ACME we've activated a temporary route and dedupe on their org while we investigate. Asking them to hold manual retries for 30m. Sending customer note now.
andrea.sre: Rolling the timeout bump to 1s on gateways handling ACME traffic now (:hourglass_flowing_sand:). Monitoring error rate and billing events.
ben.runtime: PR opened: https://git.example/redwood/billing/pulls/412 — simple dedupe window + metrics. Will deploy to staging then prod canary 1%. Need ops signoff for canary ramp.
emily.sre-lead: Actions and owners agreed:
- ben.runtime: billing dedupe PR and root-cause deep-dive (postmortem author)
- john.infra: rollback kernel patch on suspect nodes and validate TCP keepalive metrics
- dmitri.oncall: temporary route + gateway timeout bump and circuit-breaker config
- carla.support: customer communications and billing refund assessment if duplicates found
- andrea.sre: monitor dashboards and own incident comms
Please update this thread when you make changes. We'll meet for 30m war room at 09:05 UTC.
maya.product: Also collect a sample of duplicated billing events (request ids + timestamps) and flag for finance — we may need auto-refund for duplicates above threshold.
andrea.sre: Status update 08:25 UTC: gateway 502 rate down from 30%->5% after timeout bump and traffic reroute. Billing duplicates still visible but reduced. Continuing monitoring.
ben.runtime: After canary deploy of dedupe to 5% prod traffic: dedupe prevented 92% of duplicate events in the sample window. Will expand to 25% in 10m.
john.infra: Rolled back kernel patch on 3 suspect nodes in eu-west (modelhost-eu-1/2/3). Observed connection reset rate drop ~80% on those nodes.
dmitri.oncall: Circuit-breaker enabled; client retries now get 503 immediately instead of double-forward, so customer clients should see consistent failure to retry more intelligently.
carla.support: ACME replied — they see much better behavior and granted permission to keep dedupe in place for 24h. They asked for a postmortem and refund confirmation.
emily.sre-lead: Good progress. Capture these follow-ups for postmortem and assign timeline:
- Postmortem draft due EOD (ben.runtime)
- Billing refund policy + manual credits (carla.support + finance)
- Root-cause RCA on keepalive/kernel interaction (ben.runtime + john.infra) - due in 48h
- Add automated test to billing pipeline to detect duplicates (ben.runtime)
- Update runbooks for gateway timeouts + circuit-breaker thresholds (andrea.sre)
andrea.sre: Closing war room at 09:40 UTC. If further regressions appear we reopen. :white_check_mark:
